title: L'Oreal's Cannes Promo Snubs Aishwarya, Fans Revolt
excerpt: A viral Martinez hotel campaign video omits India's 20-year Cannes icon in favour of newer ambassador Alia Bhatt.
body:
Aishwarya Rai Bachchan has graced the Cannes red carpet for L'Oreal Paris for more than two decades. So when the brand posted a promotional video on May 10 — featuring ambassador posters unfurling from the iconic Martinez hotel — and left her face out entirely, fans erupted.

**What Happened:**
L'Oreal Paris shared the Cannes 2026 campaign video on Instagram, showcasing global ambassadors including Alia Bhatt, Viola Davis, Eva Longoria, and Helen Mirren. Aishwarya's poster was absent. The omission stung for millions of fans who associate her image almost inseparably with the brand's India story. Comments flooded the post: *'Without Aishwarya, L'OREAL is nothing in India.'*

**The Full Picture:**
The backlash does not match the official narrative. L'Oreal Paris confirmed in its press release that all three Indian ambassadors — Aishwarya Rai Bachchan, Alia Bhatt, and Aditi Rao Hydari — will represent India at Cannes 2026, which runs May 12 to 23 as the brand's 29th year as Official Beauty Partner. Aishwarya's manager Archana also confirmed she remains a key global ambassador and is expected on the red carpet. The controversy reflects a deeper tension: L'Oreal's aggressive push of Alia's Gen Z appeal has made older fans feel the legend is being slowly sidelined — even if the brand insists otherwise.

**What to Watch:**
Aishwarya's red carpet appearance at Cannes this week will either quiet the storm or confirm fans' worst fears about a quiet changing of the guard.
